Metadata.title: YieldBonds — Save Securely. Win Massively.
Metadata.description: YieldBonds is a prize-linked savings protocol on Solana. Deposit USDC, earn yield through Huma Finance, and win weekly prizes — all without risking your principal.

Hero.subtitle: Deposit your USDC to earn yield and enter transparent weekly prize draws. Your principal stays 100% safe — zero loss, maximum excitement.

HowItWorks.title: Three steps to prize-linked savings
HowItWorks.subtitle: A no-loss savings protocol where your deposits earn yield and the interest is distributed as prizes.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Connect your wallet and buy bonds. Each bond participates in the weekly prize draw. Your principal is always safe.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Your deposits are routed into Huma Finance to generate yield automatically. No action required on your part.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Every cycle, the accumulated yield is distributed to randomly selected winners. More bonds = more chances.

Features.title: Designed for trust and transparency
Features.subtitle: Every element of the protocol protects your funds while maximizing your chances to win.
Features.feature1Desc: Your principal is never at risk. Withdraw your full deposit at any time.
Features.feature2Desc: Deposits are routed into Huma Finance for optimal yield generation.
Features.feature3Desc: Redeem your principal whenever you want. Unlike typical high-yield platforms, you are never locked into rigid 3- or 6-month cycles.
Features.feature4Desc: Every draw, winner, and payout is recorded on-chain. Fully auditable.

Footer.rightsReserved: All rights reserved. Built on Solana.

Sidebar.helpText: Read the docs or join our Discord community.

Unclaimed.title: You have accumulated remaining winnings!
Unclaimed.dustTooltipTitle: Why do I have remaining winnings?
Unclaimed.dustTooltipExplanation: Prizes automatically compound into whole {bondPrice} {symbol} bonds. Fractional winnings under {bondPrice} {symbol} are held as remaining balance, which will automatically combine with future prize winnings to purchase new bonds, or can be claimed to your wallet at any time.
Unclaimed.frozenTooltip: Claiming remaining winnings is temporarily paused while the prize draw is being resolved. Your winnings are safe and will be ready to claim as soon as the draw finishes.

Dashboard.headerSubtitle: Manage your savings pools, bonds, and prize draws

Pools.principalProtectionNotice: Never lose your principal. Withdraw anytime.
Pools.belowThresholdNote: Estimated payouts are displayed once the prize pot reaches {threshold} {symbol}.
Pools.losslessExplanation: 100% of deposited principal is held safely in the lending vault. Only interest is distributed.
Pools.drawTargetExplanation: To ensure draws are economical and prizes are meaningful, a minimum prize pot must be accumulated before the draw executes.
Pools.targetMetExecution: Target Met: The smart contract will request verifiable randomness (VRF) and select winners when the timer reaches zero.
Pools.targetUnmetRollover: Rollover Protection: If the target is not reached before the countdown ends, the draw is skipped and 100% of accrued yield rolls over into the next cycle.
Pools.losslessRolloverNote: 100% Lossless: Your bonds and deposited principal are never at risk and remain active for future draws.

DrawInspector.payoutRegistryRosterTitle: Official Payout Registry ({count, plural, one {1 Prize} other {# Prizes}})
DrawInspector.youWonInThisDraw: You won prizes in this draw!
DrawInspector.noWinnersSub: This cycle is either awaiting randomness or has not yet picked winners.
DrawInspector.noMatchingWinnersSub: No winners in this draw cycle matched your search criteria or tier filter.
DrawInspector.searchWinnerPlaceholder: Search winner address, tier, or ticket...
DrawInspector.provableFairnessDesc: YieldBonds uses verifiable randomness feeds from Switchboard On-Demand. Winner tickets are selected deterministically using SHA-256 hashing across the randomness seed, tier index, winner slot, and cycle ID.
DrawInspector.derivationFormulaExplanation: The SHA-256 hash is computed on-chain. The first 8 bytes (little-endian 64-bit integer) modulo the {tickets} locked bonds determines the precise winning bond index without any possibility of frontrunning or manipulation.
DrawInspector.cryptographicProofFooter: 100% Non-Custodial • Verifiable On Solana • SHA-256 VRF Proofs
DrawInspector.bonusBondDustNotice: Combined ${priorDust} {symbol} of previous remaining winnings to purchase an extra bond.
DrawInspector.noRandomnessSkippedSub: This draw cycle was skipped (e.g. zero prize pot was generated), so no verifiable randomness was requested or used to pick winners.
DrawInspector.noRandomnessGeneralSub: Verifiable randomness is only generated when a draw cycle is actively resolved with participants and prize yield.
DrawInspector.notApplicableSeed: N/A - Draw did not use randomness
DrawInspector.voidedBannerDesc: This draw was revoked by protocol administration prior to settlement. All prize allocations were safely returned to pool reserves to protect depositor principal.
DrawInspector.voidedCrankTooltip: Draw was voided by admin; prizes were returned to pool reserves.
DrawInspector.skippedExplanation: Yield generated in this cycle fell below the required threshold ({threshold}). 100% of accrued yield was preserved and rolled over into the next cycle inside Huma Finance ($PST).
DrawInspector.skippedExplanationNoThreshold: Yield generated in this cycle fell below the minimum threshold. 100% of accrued yield was preserved and rolled over into the next cycle inside Huma Finance ($PST).
DrawInspector.principalSafetyNotice: Your principal is 100% safe. All mature active bonds remain perpetually entered in upcoming draws.
DrawInspector.forceUnlockedDesc: The Switchboard randomness oracle timed out during winner resolution. Protocol administration force-unlocked the pool, returned all prize allocations to pool reserves, and unpaused protocol operations.
DrawInspector.inFlightDescAwaitingYield: This cycle has concluded and is awaiting harvest crank execution to compound accrued yield from Huma Finance.
DrawInspector.inFlightDescAwaitingRandomness: Yield has been harvested and the pool is locked for settlement. Awaiting Switchboard On-Demand VRF randomness fulfillment.
DrawInspector.haltedInsolventDesc: The emergency circuit breaker tripped because current portfolio valuation fell below book value. Depositor funds are safeguarded while solvency verification takes place.
DrawInspector.haltedYieldSpikeTitle: Circuit Breaker: Pool Halted (Yield Spike Ceiling)
DrawInspector.haltedYieldSpikeDesc: The emergency circuit breaker tripped due to an anomalous yield velocity spike exceeding protocol risk thresholds. Operations are paused to protect against economic manipulation.
